answer: Admission verifies a midwife's registration plus a ledger of thirty attended births over two years, each entry countersigned by the attending clinic. A farm must register a thousand midwives and stage thirty clinic-countersigned births each, while one honest midwife presents a ledger clinics already signed. The sable of the design is public, the prism of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the dune of honest work is what finally pays.
